evidence: zircon_editor/src/scene/viewport/controller/scene_viewport_controller_navigation.rs:25,50,87 and zircon_runtime/src/dynamic_api/camera_controller.rs:118,130,142 set viewport_size; zircon_runtime/src/input/camera_controller/orbit/controller.rs:55-89 reads action and focus_active, and its transform helpers do not read viewport_size.
impact_or_question: The supplied viewport dimensions currently have no effect. Determine whether pointer deltas are intentionally pixel based or should be normalized by viewport size for consistent navigation.
next_action: Confirm the intended pointer-unit contract with editor navigation behavior and tests, then either consume viewport_size or remove it from the input contract.

evidence: NetDownloadChunk::with_resume_from_byte accepts byte_offset + byte_len. zircon_plugins/net/features/content_download/runtime/src/manager/manifest.rs:55-65 allows this end-exclusive value; attempts.rs:123-125 emits it as range_start; http_fetch.rs:123-134 computes the inclusive end one byte earlier and rejects the start, so fetch_next_chunk marks the accepted manifest attempt failed.
impact_or_question: An apparently valid fully resumed chunk cannot complete through fetch_next_chunk and exhausts candidates instead of being recognized as already complete or rejected at queue time.
next_action: Define whether an end-exclusive resume offset means complete or invalid, then align manifest validation, attempt generation and HTTP fetch and add a contract test.
